title: Both channels captured: honest frames, honest manifest, captor keys presented -> KEY_MISMATCH

source.model: S-P3 Q2 degraded, sole channel compromised (abstraction of V1 strict with both channels captured)
capstone C-C1 (case c, both channel keys public)

scenario: As E10-G10-01 but the honest manifest is kept; only keys (and possession) are the captor's.

mutations.with: by K' over the honest manifest

test_universe.like: AUTH-i-T channels; everything else from A-a

choices: 'Captured channels' = the TXT signed under the trusted DNSSEC path and the assertion committed by the configured repository key, both naming the captor's keys K' (AUTH-i-T's channel material).
DSKS (the model's derived key) is not achievable for fixed-generator P-256 with a known private key; the captor's own key K' stands in for it.
Reading S-P3's degraded sole-channel model as V1 strict with both channels captured is the extractor's reading (the S-P3 H1 header says only 'strict ... not weaker').

subcases.construction: TEST issue with captor keys, adversarial; manifest_value hook: the honest manifest; asig hook: A-a's honest A_sig; keys and possession (over the honest manifest) by the captor; both channels name the captor's keys
subcases.T_derivation: T = nTime(h*) of the fixture's own receipt proof and headers (a_sig and receipt_anchor as stamped; rows 11.1-11.4 pass); U = 7200 + max nTime(h*..h*+5) (A10.1.1)
